interface_contract.command_bram: native Port B cmd_enb/cmd_addrb/cmd_doutb, separate from data banks
interface_contract.pc_policy: strict current-PC with no lookahead; advance only on request acceptance
interface_contract.outstanding_policy: up to one fixed command per distinct data bank; maximum 16 at default parameters
interface_contract.response_policy: bounds-checked tag match releases independently of current PC
interface_contract.terminal_policy: END or error drains pending entries and external bank_busy before terminal status

simulation.tool: Vivado XSIM 2025.2 exact generated xsimk snapshot
coverage: command BRAM word address zero independent of data bank zero
data bank zero acquire release and reuse
two distinct-bank MM2S requests accepted before either completion
distinct-bank MM2S and S2MM simultaneously pending
MM2S and S2MM valid and typed payload stability under backpressure
same-bank stall at current PC with no later fetch
matching completion release during later fetch and during later stall
simultaneous independent MM2S and S2MM releases
spurious wrong-type and mismatched status produce no release
executor error releases matching bank and error-drains
END waits for pending entries and external bank_busy
unknown opcode and zero byte-count rejection
reset recovery from fetch issue and drain states
1024 non-END commands accepted through PC 1023 then bounded missing-END error
all required marker regions compile unmodified and marker sentinel is dynamically checked

resources.interpretation: control-only template; command BRAM and data-bank memories are intentionally external

does_not_claim: AXI BRAM Controller instantiation or address assignment
command BRAM or data-bank memory implementation
user compute executor ports or behavior
board integration, bitstream, or physical-board validation
